title: FDA PCAC briefing: BPC-157 (free base) and BPC-157 acetate (July 2026)
claim: FDA evaluation: substances not well characterized; immunogenicity concerns for injectable/nasal routes; 28-day animal studies showed coagulopathy and liver safety signals; human data limited to small studies and one UC meeting abstract; FDA proposed against 503A inclusion. Committee voted 8–6 (1 abstention) to recommend inclusion; final FDA action pending.
